title: Academic Integrity & Similarity Reports
tagline: Understand plagiarism policies, interpret Turnitin reports, and use AI ethically.
outcomes: Navigate HEC Pakistan plagiarism thresholds (maximum 19% overall, 5% single source) and institutional variations.
Distinguish between superficial textual overlap and genuine plagiarism in Turnitin reports.
Master the 4-step paraphrasing method to express complex research findings in your own scholarly voice.
Draft transparent, compliant AI tool usage disclosure statements for thesis submission.

modules.title: Module 1: Forms of Plagiarism & HEC Policy
modules.description: Understand direct plagiarism, mosaic borrowing, self-plagiarism, and official HEC regulations.

lessons.title: HEC Pakistan Plagiarism Policy & Thresholds Explained

modules.title: Module 2: Reading Turnitin & Similarity Reports
modules.description: Analyze similarity percentages, interpret source match breakdowns, and understand legitimate exclusions.

lessons.title: Overall Index vs Individual Source Matching

modules.title: Module 3: Paraphrasing & Academic Synthesis
modules.description: Transform source texts using structural restructuring, synonymization, and synthesis without plagiarizing.

lessons.title: The 4-Step Paraphrasing Technique That Never Fails
When to Quote Directly vs When to Synthesize

modules.title: Module 4: Generative AI Ethics, Disclosure & Final Check
modules.description: Learn ethical boundaries for GenAI assistance, institutional declaration requirements, and pre-submission checks.

lessons.title: AI Tools in Academic Research: Ethical Boundaries
How to Write an AI Assistance Disclosure Statement
